inputs.name: phase_2_specification
inputs.meaning: Accepted architecture training and generalization contracts

outputs.name: release_evidence
outputs.meaning: Selected checkpoint and protected evaluation results

trust_boundaries: Test evidence remains sealed until validation selection is complete
Checkpoint loading requires trusted local provenance

acceptance_criteria: Known-good training and all lab tests pass.
Shapes gradients lifecycle and checkpoint metadata satisfy P2-I01 through P2-I05.
Controlled failure stops without promoting a checkpoint and recovery is reproducible.
failure_behavior: Nonfinite or explosive loss stops training and prevents checkpoint promotion.
Shape mismatch reports expected and received shapes before model execution continues.

decision.rationale: The lab converts the accepted Phase 2 specification into a tested implementation and establishes programming readiness.
open_questions: Does the learner need additional syntax practice before Lesson 11?
